messages:
Aisha (PM): Heads-up: quick sync thread for the pricing microsim experiment. Scope: FAQ edits, three new slab names (we'll A/B), tiny embedded calc, and inbound routing for webinar signups. Publish window Tue 9am PT.
Tom (Growth): I'll write the launch blurb and the benchmark pull-quote. Need cost-per-1k tokens and P95 latency from Marco.
Marco (Data): Uploaded csv with sims and assumptions. Topline: quantized + caching reduces median spend ~28% on typical prompt mix. P95 numbers attached in doc.
Rina (Content): I'll revise FAQ. New Qs to add: EU VAT implications, how rollouts affect billing, and what "burst capacity" means for Dedicated.
Lee (Design): Working on compact calculator UI and three-tier badges. Figma: https://www.figma.com/pricing-microsim. I'll export responsive SVGs by Mon.
Tom (Growth): Proposed slab names for A/B test: A = "Launch / Scale / Enterprise", B = "Pilot / Ramp / Anchor". Tom will seed 25% traffic to B for two weeks.
Aisha (PM): Also decision: should webinar registrants get full calc result emailed? Ops/Privacy check.
Sam (Ops): Prefer opt-in checkbox. We'll only email results if registrant consents. Also routing: webinar -> mktg-nurture; leads with expected_commit >= 4000 -> sales via webhook.
Marco (Data): Quick calc snippet for blog (example): 1M tokens/mo -> ~$220 (hosted median, with small-model mix). I'll drop exact numbers into the doc.
Rina (Content): Draft FAQ line for caching: "Caching reduces billable tokens for repeated prefixes; enable prefix cache in Dedicated for best savings." Will include link to docs.
Lee (Design): Dev embed snippet for micro-calculator (mobile-safe):
```
<!-- pricing micro-calc embed -->
<iframe src="https://redwood.example/embed/microsim?theme=compact" width="100%" height="360" title="Pricing calculator"></iframe>
```
Tom (Growth): We'll tag events: pricing_calc_used, tier_variant=A|B, webinar_reg=true. Marco, can you ensure the CSV maps to those tags?
Marco (Data): Will add analytics mapping and a sample chart for the blog (P50/P95 latency + per-1k cost bands).
Aisha (PM): Owners: Tom = launch post + A/B; Rina = FAQ + webinar copy; Lee = visuals + embed; Marco = numbers + analytics tags; Sam = routing & consent. Freeze content Mon EOD. Any blockers?
Sam (Ops): Small one: legal asked to include EU VAT note on the page. Rina, can you add one line under pricing table?
